deepseek.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one cohesive art-direction sample for an original high-quality anime action game's DeepSeek-themed menu/dialog UI, as a polished hand-painted raster game UI artwork, NOT plain vector rectangles or a website.
Input image 1 is DeepSeek CHARACTER PALETTE / craftsmanship reference only: do not include or redraw the character. Input image 2 is her targeting VFX SHAPE LANGUAGE reference only: soften and simplify its luminous ring and rice-grain motifs for comfortable everyday UI.
The sample is one large landscape dialog window with a subtle header crest, an empty generous readable central content area, and two elegantly illustrated blank horizontal buttons along its lower inside edge. Exact front view, aligned flat 2D, no perspective. Canvas roughly 1536x1024, window about 85% width and 72% height with clear exterior margins.
Visual design: deep ocean-blue translucent-looking enamel/glass inner panel, pearl-white / silver thin nested edging, soft azure reflected light, restrained flowing orca-fin / water-current curves at the corners, tiny rice-grain inlays worked into a small top crest. Beautiful custom-shaped border with two or three delicate constructed layers, a softly recessed inner surface and finely painted edge highlights. The button art has nested ivory and blue rims and a soft inner sheen. One primary pale-azure button and one quieter dark blue button. Large quiet centers for Unity-rendered text. Graceful and comfortable, sophisticated anime game menu clarity and breathing room, not gaudy rococo and not plastic mobile casino UI. Intricate only at corner accents, mostly clean long edges; do not fill every edge with filigree. Fine outlines matching the character's clean anime rendering. Small local light, no bloom cloud.
Deliver this preview as a single composed dialog design on REAL TRANSPARENT alpha exterior, no environment, no checkerboard, no colored display background. Inside the panel remains a readable dark-blue painted surface, not an empty frame. No lettering, no labels, no fake text, no logo, no watermark, no human figures. Original motif design.
